title: Coal India Q1 Results: Profit Flat Even As Revenue Rises 8%, Dividend Declared; Check Record Date
summary: Coal India reported a marginal 0.6% rise in Q1 net profit to Rs 8,852 crore while revenue increased 7.8% to Rs 46,255 crore. The company declared an interim dividend of Rs 5.50 per share, with the record date set for July 31, 2026 and payment by August 25, 2026. Shares showed little movement, and the stock trades with a market cap of Rs 2.43 lakh crore and a P/E of 7.58.
content:
Coal India Ltd. saw a 0.6% uptick in its net profit to Rs 8,852 crore for the quarter ended June 30, according to an exchange filing from the firm. The company reported a profit of Rs 8,797 crore in the previous fiscal for the same period.

The firm declared an interim dividend of Rs 5.50 per share. The record date for determining eligibility of shareholders is Jul 31, 2026. The dividend amount will be paid out on or before Aug. 25, 2026.

ALSO READ: Godfrey Phillips Q1 Results: Profit Falls 44%, Margins Contract Sharply

The public sector undertaking's revenue rose 7.8% to Rs 46,255 crore year-on-year, up from Rs 42,919 crore in the same quarter last year.

Coal India Ltd.'s share price saw a 0.02% uptick to settle at Rs 427.50 at the end of the day's trade, compared to a 0.96% uptick in the NSE Nifty 50.

As of July 2026, Coal India Ltd. share price stood at Rs 427.50. The stock opened at Rs 429.50, compared to its previous close of Rs 427.40. During the trading session, the share price moved in the range of Rs 425.75 to Rs 431.00.

ALSO READ: Canara Bank To Hire 3,000-4,000 Employees In FY27; Sees Strong Credit Demand, No El Nio Impact Yet

Looking at its last 52-week performance, the stock has touched a low of Rs 368.65 and a high of Rs 491.25. On the performance front, Coal India Ltd. share price is up 12.26% on a year-on-year basis.

The market capitalisation of Coal India Ltd. is Rs 2.43 lakh crore, with a P/E ratio of 7.58.

## Financial results (quarter ended June 30)

Coal India Ltd. saw a 0.6% uptick in its net profit to Rs 8,852 crore for the quarter ended June 30, according to an exchange filing from the firm. The company reported a profit of Rs 8,797 crore in the previous fiscal for the same period.

## Dividend

The firm declared an interim dividend of Rs 5.50 per share. The record date for determining eligibility of shareholders is Jul 31, 2026. The dividend amount will be paid out on or before Aug. 25, 2026.

## Revenue

The public sector undertaking's revenue rose 7.8% to Rs 46,255 crore year-on-year, up from Rs 42,919 crore in the same quarter last year.

## Share performance

- Coal India Ltd.'s share price saw a 0.02% uptick to settle at Rs 427.50 at the end of the day's trade, compared to a 0.96% uptick in the NSE Nifty 50.
- As of July 2026, Coal India Ltd. share price stood at Rs 427.50.
- The stock opened at Rs 429.50, compared to its previous close of Rs 427.40.
- During the trading session, the share price moved in the range of Rs 425.75 to Rs 431.00.

## 52-week performance and valuation

- 52-week low: Rs 368.65
- 52-week high: Rs 491.25
- Year-on-year performance: up 12.26%
- Market capitalisation: Rs 2.43 lakh crore
- P/E ratio: 7.58
